observer_route: EffectiveGrantDestination.observe() → same in-process SQLite file as writer
access_separation: none — same OS user, same Python process, same destination object
trust_boundary_label: local synthetic oracle (NOT an independent external witness)
consistency: read-after-close: destination.observe called after executor.execute returns
horizon: bounded by test teardown; delayed commits after teardown cannot be detected by this observer
blind_spots: out-of-process writer that bypasses the executor path entirely
storage-layer corruption not exposed to PRAGMA integrity_check during execution (checked only on exported snapshot in destination/)
external principals observing side-channels this observer does not see
